name: Linear
summary: Your Linear issues as Sonar's tickets
description: Linear as Sonar's ticket tracker, with a key for each project: it reads your workspace, the issues Sonar asks for and the open ones to link, and changes the state of an issue when Sonar asks it to.

fr.description: Linear comme suivi de tickets de Sonar, avec une clé par projet : il lit ton espace de travail, les tickets que Sonar demande et les tickets ouverts à lier, et change l'état d'un ticket quand Sonar le demande.

key.why: Elle ouvre les tickets du projet dans Linear. Crée-la dans Linear : Settings, API, Personal API keys.

keys.name: key
keys.label: Linear
keys.why: It opens the project's issues in Linear. Create it in Linear: Settings, API, Personal API keys.
